messages:
carmen: observed an OOM spike at 21:30 across shards 4-6. Heap shows steady growth in small-object residency (48-80B). Likely fragmentation + missed LRU touches.
lee: thanks. is this same pattern as last month's postmortem or a new variant?
oscar: looks related but with an extra vector: batch-merge leaves pinned 'delta' objects until compaction. GC runs but compactor isn't aggressive enough.
nina: assign quick owners: carmen -> heap diffs & repro; lee -> allocator config change (pooled slabs for 48-80B); oscar -> compaction policy tweak + metrics. I'll own canary rollout.
carmen: repro script uploaded: gitlab.com/redwood/kv/repro/oom_small_allocs.py. It reproduces residency climb in ~30m at 5k qps.
lee: opened PR #5334 to enable pooling for the 48-80B bucket and emit allocator.pool.hit_rate. Small smoke tests in CI included.
oscar: compaction tweak: add a short aggressive compaction pass after sustained +6% residency delta in 10m. Will also add metric kv.compactor.reclaimed_bytes.
nina: canary plan: 2 nodes in eu-west, enable pooling + compaction tweak, monitor eviction.reclaimed_bytes, kv.residency.percent, p95 latency. Canary window 4h.
carmen: added INF-9915 with heap diffs and links to PRs. Please add updates there.
sre-bot: Canary started at 3513001200 on nodes node-4,node-6. Alerts: residency>70% warn, >85% page.
lee: early signal after 1h: pool hit_rate 18% -> 64%, reclaimed_bytes up, p95 latency +2%. No OOMs so far.
oscar: merging compaction tweak to canary branch at 3513001800.
nina: follow-ups for postmortem: - add AllocatorTest.SmallObjectBurst (lee) - schedule staggered compaction windows by shard id (oscar) - finalize rollout playbook + rollback (nina). Meeting tomorrow 09:30 to review.
carmen: thanks team. Good ops; please ensure unit tests land before full rollout.
